name: How does a lower countertop impact resale value in Pacifica?

mainEntity.name: How does a lower countertop impact resale value in Pacifica?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pacifica, as in other areas, the impact on resale value depends on market demand. While a standard countertop height appeals to the broadest audience, a well-executed lower countertop installation can be a significant asset for buyers seeking accessible homes or those with specific ergonomic needs. It can be a unique selling point if marketed correctly, but it's not a universal upgrade for all buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Pacifica, it can be a unique selling point for accessible homes but might not appeal to all buyers; execution quality is key.
